mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS grows and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% signals robust demand momentum that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.5% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate consistently indicates strengthening labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals supply disruption that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate policy response to inflation that raises equity discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions, industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 90.0 signals deepening supply contraction that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0 during recession, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
